name: Agni Sword
aliases: Agni_Sword_US swordsman knight crusader merchant thief
summary: Restore the Swordsman family alongside Merchant and Thief.
description: Allows both Swordsman advancement branches, alongside Merchant and Thief families, through normal and advanced job tiers. The item keeps its existing level requirement, stats and effects.

name: Heretic Acolyte Boots
aliases: Stray_Acolyte_US inquisitor acolyte priest monk merchant blacksmith whitesmith mastersmith
description: Allows the Acolyte, Priest and Monk branches, plus Merchant and Blacksmith branches, at minimum level 100. The existing requirements for advanced job tiers still apply. Its separate transfer switch allows trading, personal storage and mail.

name: Cocytus Armor
aliases: Cocytus_Armor_US cold bolt storm gust jack frost grade refine armor
summary: Keep the working bonuses, grade effects and +12 autocasts together.
description: Restores refine and grade bonuses. At +12, normal melee attacks can trigger Cold Bolt and Storm Gust. Grade A adds Cold Bolt → Jack Frost. This switch enables the complete armor repair.
notice: The supplied repair blocks dropping, trading, personal storage and cart by default. The menus below can override trading, storage and cart. Keep original adds no extra permission patch; the active armor repair and other mods still apply.
